export_policy: Numeric evidence and scientific scope only. No blind runner, model/Tape/VJP/runtime source, model tensors, conversations or operational settings.
historical_field_handling: The source status publication_of_this_round=false describes the old source snapshot. It is neither overwritten nor used as a current publication verdict.
verification_limits: The private source snapshots, frozen runner and full tensors are not included.

The public reader recalculates reported worst-coordinate arithmetic and role-to-case-to-summary counts. It cannot independently search full tensors, certify their reported failure counts, or rerun the model.
SHA-256 pins identify bytes; they do not establish author identity if the entire provenance record is replaced.
